## Data

orca <- read.table("http://www.stats4life.se/data/oralca.txt", stringsAsFactors = TRUE)
head(orca)

## Survival Data


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
orca |> 
    mutate(all = event != "Alive") -> orca
table(orca$all)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```

FALSE  TRUE 
  109   229 
```
